evals.name: fresh-setup-mixed-repo
evals.prompt: I've got this little repo with a Python script, a deploy shell script, a Dockerfile, and some YAML. Set up linting for it — pick good linters for each file type and make it so they get run before any commit. I'm on a Mac.
evals.expected_output: Detects Python/Shell/Dockerfile/YAML, consults super-linter for current linters, recommends primary linters (ruff, shellcheck, hadolint, yamllint), asks before installing, writes a ## Linting section into AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md requiring lint-before-commit, adds a `make lint` target, documents it in README.

assertions.text: An AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md file contains a '## Linting' section
The Linting section states linters must run/pass before committing
A Makefile defines a `lint` target that runs the chosen linters
README.md documents how to run the linters (e.g. `make lint`)
Output indicates super-linter was consulted as the source of linter choices
Enforcement uses AGENTS.md instructions + make lint, without installing an unrequested git pre-commit hook or pre-commit framework

evals.name: scoped-new-filetypes
evals.prompt: I'm about to start adding Terraform modules and a few bash scripts to this repo. Before I do, set me up with the right linters for those and make running them a required step before I commit.
evals.expected_output: Scopes to Terraform and Shell (does not try to lint every file type in the repo), uses super-linter to pick tflint and shellcheck, gives install + run commands, writes the lint-before-commit expectation into the agent guide, adds make lint. Mentions optional extras (checkov/trivy) without forcing them.

assertions.text: An AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md file contains a '## Linting' section requiring lint-before-commit
Scopes to Terraform + Shell only; does NOT add Python/Markdown linters for the existing main.py/README.md
A Makefile defines a `lint` target running tflint and shellcheck
Mentions optional security extras (checkov/trivy) without installing them by default
Enforcement uses AGENTS.md instructions + make lint, without an unrequested git hook / pre-commit framework

evals.name: single-language-claude-md
evals.prompt: what's the current best linter for python? add it to my CLAUDE.md so you always run it before committing my changes
evals.expected_output: Fetches super-linter to confirm the current Python linter (ruff), explains why, gives install + run command, and edits the existing CLAUDE.md to add a linting expectation that the agent runs the linter before commits. Should not over-install or add unrelated linters.

assertions.text: The existing CLAUDE.md is edited to add a Linting section requiring the linter run before commits
Identifies ruff as the current best Python linter
Scopes to Python only; adds no unrelated linters
Does not install or require a wall of extra linters beyond the primary pick
